meta.title: Scheduling Software Features | AgenditApp
meta.description: 24/7 online booking, automated WhatsApp reminders, client loyalty, staff management, commissions, and a booking website — all in one platform. No contracts.
meta.ogDescription: Explore every tool AgenditApp offers to automate bookings, WhatsApp messaging, client loyalty, and complete business management.

hero.subtitle: AgenditApp helps you automate bookings, WhatsApp messaging, client loyalty, and complete business management so you can grow without the hassle.

features.descripcion: Your clients book from your website anytime, with no phone calls or waiting.
Take as many bookings as you need — no monthly limits and no per-appointment fees.
An intuitive calendar with day/week views and clear organization by staff member and service.
Set the duration, price, and availability of each service. Adjust your catalog whenever you want.
Configure working hours and availability for online booking to match how your business actually runs.
Block out breaks, meetings, or special events easily to avoid overbooking.

features.nombre: WhatsApp messages from your own number
features.descripcion: Automate messages from your WhatsApp Business number (available on the Essential and Own Brand plans).
Every time a client books, they get a WhatsApp confirmation message. The message text is fully customizable.
Cut no-shows with reminders sent before each appointment. On the Own Brand plan, you can send 2 reminders at configurable times.
Your clients can confirm their attendance or cancel their appointment directly from the message.

features.nombre: Editable messages, in your own voice
features.descripcion: Customize your WhatsApp message text to match your brand's tone and policies.
Get instant alerts whenever a new booking comes in or an appointment changes.
Add staff members, assign services, and manage each person's individual calendar with full control.

features.nombre: Commissions and payroll per staff member
features.descripcion: Calculate commissions per service and keep organized track of payouts or payroll.
A client database with appointment history, notes, and better follow-up.
Track peak hours, best-selling services, staff performance, and how your business is growing.
Log payments and payment methods, and generate reports for clear visibility into your revenue.

features.nombre: Deposit or full payment at booking
features.descripcion: Clients can pay a deposit or the full price of their appointment when booking, to secure the slot and reduce no-shows. Available on the Basic, Essential, and Own Brand plans.
Accept credit and debit card payments online through our integrated payment processor. A standard per-transaction processing fee applies.
Clients upload proof of payment and you confirm it from your dashboard yourself. No processing fee.

features.nombre: Same payment options for other charges
features.descripcion: Use card payments or manual payment confirmation for store sales and other business charges too, not just bookings.
Sell packages of multiple sessions for the same service — for example, 4 massage sessions — and the system automatically deducts each session your client uses. Exclusive to the Own Brand plan.
Check at any time how many sessions each client has left in their package, with no need for a separate spreadsheet.
Track the supplies you use for each service and avoid running out at the worst possible moment. Available on the Basic, Essential, and Own Brand plans.
Sell products directly from your page, in addition to your appointment-based services.
Clear visibility into your supply levels and the products you sell.
Reward frequent clients with perks and increase repeat visits effortlessly.
Confirmations, reminders, and easy booking keep clients coming back more often.
A welcome page with your services and a booking button. On Own Brand, it looks even more professional.
On the Basic and Essential plans, you get a subdomain like: your-business.agenditapp.com.
Use your own domain (e.g., yourbrand.com) for a stronger online presence and more trust.
Your page looks great on phones, tablets, and computers.
Your site is built to show up in Google search results.
Send campaigns to your client base for promotions, re-engagement, and important announcements.
Organize your client base for more effective campaigns.
The platform adapts to your brand for a more professional experience.
Your information is protected with strong security practices and automatic backups.
Manage your business from your phone, tablet, or computer, wherever you are.
Help via WhatsApp and email to answer questions and get everything set up.
Always get improvements and new features with nothing to install and no extra cost.

highlights.title: Fast setup
highlights.desc: Start taking bookings quickly. We help you with initial setup.

highlights.title: No long-term contracts
highlights.desc: Pay month to month. Cancel anytime, with no clauses or penalties.

highlights.title: Easy to use
highlights.desc: An intuitive interface for you and your team. No technical skills required.
